requirement: Maintain stressed collateral coverage at or above the required coverage ratio.
cure_period: one business day by cash repayment or eligible collateral top-up
breach_consequence: Block new draws and require cure; escalate unresolved deficiency for default or waiver analysis.

requirement: Preserve verified ownership, first priority, and enforceable lender control over eligible collateral.
test_frequency: continuous and on any custody or control change
cure_period: no draw availability during any deficiency
breach_consequence: Assign zero collateral credit, block funding, and begin immediate legal review.

requirement: Maintain a tested collateral-to-cash repayment route within the approved completion time.
test_frequency: monthly and after any route change
cure_period: availability suspended until a successful test
breach_consequence: Suspend availability and require same-day operations and credit review.

requirement: Maintain minimum unrestricted cash at the borrowing entity.
cure_period: five business days to deliver a remediation plan; availability remains frozen
breach_consequence: Freeze incremental availability and reassess repayment capacity and the obligor cap.

requirement: Explain and remediate material adverse variance to the approved operating cash forecast.
cure_period: five business days to provide an updated forecast and action plan
breach_consequence: Refresh the rating and repayment analysis; freeze availability if liquidity runway is affected.

requirement: Do not incur additional secured debt or create liens without lender consent.
cure_period: none unless expressly waived in writing
breach_consequence: Block new draws and assess default, release, subordination, or waiver requirements.

requirement: Remain within the approved USDC collateral concentration capacity.
cure_period: no draw may create or increase a breach
breach_consequence: Reject the draw or reduce the facility limit before funding.

requirement: Deliver complete financial and collateral reporting after each month end.
breach_consequence: Block new draws until the reporting package is complete and accepted.
